$comment: Review CORE contract conformance vectors. Generated by generate.ts (see its header): `canonical` through core canonicalJson; `ingest`, `upsert` and `set` verdicts written by hand. Run by packages/core test/reviewCoreContract.test.ts (canonical) and apps/pdfmarkuptool/functions src/review/vectors.test.ts. In `upsert`, an op_hash of OPHASH stands for the call's own fingerprint (the runner substitutes it).

canonical.name: keys sorted at every depth, no whitespace
integral numbers as integers, fractions shortest
unicode passes through; control characters escaped

ingest.name: CAS success: r1 -> r2, nothing moved
stale-revision: the document moved to r2 since the render
stale-revision: expected none, the document has one
idempotent replay: the same op_id returns the revision it wrote
replay with a different package under the same op_id
page moved: pageNumber follows the page_id; the Set block is replaced in place
page removed: parked with a reason where the v7 table allows it

data.needs_human_reason: page model-1:A103 is no longer in document doc-a (removed from the source)

ingest.name: page geometry changed: parked (points are not transformed)
first revision of a pre-revision session: n continues version, no parent, no geometry check
the storage object of the current revision is refused (never overwritten)

upsert.name: no-op: the same ordered page hashes + docdata write nothing
no-op in patch mode: a page re-sent with its current hash
replace: one page changed, one removed, one added; Set updated in place, the new page after the block
patch: change one, add one, remove one -- the rest carried over
docdata only (a property edit): a new revision, every page unchanged
markups re-anchored: a moved page renumbers, a removed page parks
create: a new document -> r1, appended at the Set end
stale-revision: the document moved on since the caller read it
stale-revision: the assembled PDF was stored for another revision number
op_id replay: the revision this op_id wrote is returned, nothing re-applied
op_id reused for a different call
patch on a review.ingest (whole-package) revision is refused
remove names a page the revision does not hold
a page_hash that is not sha256 hex
a page set.update excluded is not re-appended (a new page_id still is)

set.name: no-op: the same order and membership write nothing
exclude a page: it leaves the Set and is recorded in setExcluded
include an excluded page again (anywhere in the order)
an exclusion whose page the document no longer holds is dropped
the drafter may edit the Set
stale-set: the Set changed since the caller read it
stale-revision: an entry names a revision that is not the current one of its document
an entry names a page the revision does not hold
an entry names a document the project does not hold
expected is not a set hash
